concerns.text: The plan includes a ‘Training‑period Correlation (optional exploratory)’ phase that is not referenced by any functional requirement (FR) or success criterion (SC) in the specification. This represents an over‑reach beyond the spec’s mandated deliverables.

The plan defines an ‘End‑to‑end test’ phase that is not linked to any FR or SC in the spec. While testing is good practice, the specification does not require a dedicated end‑to‑end test artifact, so this element is extraneous to the spec.
